Jock Landale.name: Jock Landale
Jock Landale.comment: Landale (hip) won't play Sunday against the Pistons.

Asa Newell.name: Asa Newell
Asa Newell.comment: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

CJ McCollum.name: CJ McCollum
CJ McCollum.comment: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

Mouhamed Gueye.name: Mouhamed Gueye
Mouhamed Gueye.comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

Henri Veesaar.name: Henri Veesaar
Henri Veesaar.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

Mitchell Robinson.name: Mitchell Robinson
Mitchell Robinson.comment: Robinson (illness) is out for Tuesday's game against Washington, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

Nolan Traore.name: Nolan Traore
Nolan Traore.comment: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

Ryan Kalkbrenner.name: Ryan Kalkbrenner
Ryan Kalkbrenner.comment: Kalkbrenner (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's matchup with Chicago.

Grayson Allen.name: Grayson Allen
Grayson Allen.comment: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Chicago.

Dennis Schroder.name: Dennis Schroder
Dennis Schroder.comment: Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.

Kon Knueppel.name: Kon Knueppel
Kon Knueppel.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

Jalen Smith.name: Jalen Smith
Jalen Smith.comment: Smith (illness) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Charlotte.

Norman Powell.name: Norman Powell
Norman Powell.comment: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.

Caleb Wilson.name: Caleb Wilson
Caleb Wilson.comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Nae'Qwan Tomlin.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
Nae'Qwan Tomlin.comment: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

Evan Mobley.name: Evan Mobley
Evan Mobley.comment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

Tobi Lawal.name: Tobi Lawal
Tobi Lawal.comment: Lawal (groin) is out for Tuesday's game against Denver.

Dereck Lively II.name: Dereck Lively II
Dereck Lively II.comment: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that Lively (foot) is moving well and progressing in his recovery, and the big man told May he's "close" to returning, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

Sergio de Larrea.name: Sergio de Larrea
Sergio de Larrea.comment: De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

Tarik Biberovic.name: Tarik Biberovic
Tarik Biberovic.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

Cade Cunningham.name: Cade Cunningham
Cade Cunningham.comment: Cunningham (knee) is listed as out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

Ebuka Okorie.name: Ebuka Okorie
Ebuka Okorie.comment: The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.

Taurean Prince.name: Taurean Prince
Taurean Prince.comment: Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Duncan Robinson.name: Duncan Robinson
Duncan Robinson.comment: Robinson (quadriceps) is considered day-to-day as he progresses in his rehab, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Jalen Duren.name: Jalen Duren
Jalen Duren.comment: Duren (hamstring) is being assigned to the Motor City Cruise on Wednesday for practice as he ramps up for a return, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Yaxel Lendeborg.name: Yaxel Lendeborg
Yaxel Lendeborg.comment: Lendeborg is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Kings with an illness.

Brandon Williams.name: Brandon Williams
Brandon Williams.comment: Head coach Steve Kerr said Tuesday that Williams (hamstring) is questionable to play Wednesday against the Kings, per Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area.

Stephen Curry.name: Stephen Curry
Stephen Curry.comment: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Kristaps Porzingis.name: Kristaps Porzingis
Kristaps Porzingis.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

Moses Moody.name: Moses Moody
Moses Moody.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Jimmy Butler III.name: Jimmy Butler III
Jimmy Butler III.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

T.J. McConnell.name: T.J. McConnell
T.J. McConnell.comment: McConnell (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Tyrese Haliburton.name: Tyrese Haliburton
Tyrese Haliburton.comment: Haliburton (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

Aaron Nesmith.name: Aaron Nesmith
Aaron Nesmith.comment: Nesmith is out for Monday's game against the Thunder due to right foot soreness.

Larry Nance Jr..name: Larry Nance Jr.
Larry Nance Jr..comment: Nance exited Monday's game against the Thunder due to a sore right ankle and he will not return, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

Ben Sheppard.name: Ben Sheppard
Ben Sheppard.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

Bradley Beal.name: Bradley Beal
Bradley Beal.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

Jordan Miller.name: Jordan Miller
Jordan Miller.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

Austin Reaves.name: Austin Reaves
Austin Reaves.comment: Reaves (heel) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

Scotty Pippen Jr..name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
Scotty Pippen Jr..comment: Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

Cameron Boozer.name: Cameron Boozer
Cameron Boozer.comment: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Jerami Grant.name: Jerami Grant
Jerami Grant.comment: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

GG Jackson.name: GG Jackson
GG Jackson.comment: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

Richie Saunders.name: Richie Saunders
Richie Saunders.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Donte DiVincenzo.name: Donte DiVincenzo
Donte DiVincenzo.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

Jaylen Clark.name: Jaylen Clark
Jaylen Clark.comment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

Anthony Edwards.name: Anthony Edwards
Anthony Edwards.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

Julian Reese.name: Julian Reese
Julian Reese.comment: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.

Trendon Watford.name: Trendon Watford
Trendon Watford.comment: Watford (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

Bennedict Mathurin.name: Bennedict Mathurin
Bennedict Mathurin.comment: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

Dejounte Murray.name: Dejounte Murray
Dejounte Murray.comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

Miles McBride.name: Miles McBride
Miles McBride.comment: McBride (adductor) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

Jordan Clarkson.name: Jordan Clarkson
Jordan Clarkson.comment: Clarkson (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

OG Anunoby.name: OG Anunoby
OG Anunoby.comment: Anunoby (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

Nikola Topic.name: Nikola Topic
Nikola Topic.comment: Topic (hip) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Minnesota.

Jaylin Williams.name: Jaylin Williams
Jaylin Williams.comment: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

Aday Mara.name: Aday Mara
Aday Mara.comment: Mara (leg) is out for Wednesday's game versus the Timberwolves.

Jalen Williams.name: Jalen Williams
Jalen Williams.comment: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

Thomas Sorber.name: Thomas Sorber
Thomas Sorber.comment: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

Cason Wallace.name: Cason Wallace
Cason Wallace.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

Chet Holmgren.name: Chet Holmgren
Chet Holmgren.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

Jonathan Isaac.name: Jonathan Isaac
Jonathan Isaac.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

Izaiyah Nelson.name: Izaiyah Nelson
Izaiyah Nelson.comment: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Noah Penda.name: Noah Penda
Noah Penda.comment: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Paolo Banchero.name: Paolo Banchero
Paolo Banchero.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Joel Embiid.name: Joel Embiid
Joel Embiid.comment: Embiid (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against Miami, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

Ariel Hukporti.name: Ariel Hukporti
Ariel Hukporti.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Mark Williams.name: Mark Williams
Mark Williams.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Chris Youngblood.name: Chris Youngblood
Chris Youngblood.comment: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

Vit Krejci.name: Vit Krejci
Vit Krejci.comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Ja Morant.name: Ja Morant
Ja Morant.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

Shaedon Sharpe.name: Shaedon Sharpe
Shaedon Sharpe.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Zach LaVine.name: Zach LaVine
Zach LaVine.comment: LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.

Maxime Raynaud.name: Maxime Raynaud
Maxime Raynaud.comment: Raynaud (knee) was recalled from the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

Ben Simmons.name: Ben Simmons
Ben Simmons.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

De'Aaron Fox.name: De'Aaron Fox
De'Aaron Fox.comment: Fox (shin) is questionable to play Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers.

Victor Wembanyama.name: Victor Wembanyama
Victor Wembanyama.comment: Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Wednesday's game in Portland.

Dylan Harper.name: Dylan Harper
Dylan Harper.comment: Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Tobias Harris.name: Tobias Harris
Tobias Harris.comment: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

Jayden Quaintance.name: Jayden Quaintance
Jayden Quaintance.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

Kawhi Leonard.name: Kawhi Leonard
Kawhi Leonard.comment: Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

Nate Bittle.name: Nate Bittle
Nate Bittle.comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

RJ Barrett.name: RJ Barrett
RJ Barrett.comment: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Jaxson Hayes.name: Jaxson Hayes
Jaxson Hayes.comment: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

Jusuf Nurkic.name: Jusuf Nurkic
Jusuf Nurkic.comment: Nurkic (foot) has been cleared for on-court work and will be re-evaluated in one week.

Lauri Markkanen.name: Lauri Markkanen
Lauri Markkanen.comment: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Jaren Jackson Jr..name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
Jaren Jackson Jr..comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Tristan Vukcevic.name: Tristan Vukcevic
Tristan Vukcevic.comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.

Reece Beekman.name: Reece Beekman
Reece Beekman.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

Justin Champagnie.name: Justin Champagnie
Justin Champagnie.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

Jamir Watkins.name: Jamir Watkins
Jamir Watkins.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
